purpose: A clock face. The numbers stay where they are, and each hand runs from ● towards the number it points at, drawn with │, ─, ╱ or ╲, with H at the tip of the hour hand and M at the tip of the minute hand. A hand points straight at 12, 3, 6 or 9 and only roughly at the others, so the question gives the time in words as well.
